    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.shiftedHomFinrank_eq_of_term_isos (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P Q V : TwoTerm R) (e₁ : P.source ≅ Q.source) (e₀ : P.target ≅ Q.target) (h : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e₁.hom Q.differential = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp P.differential e₀.hom) :

    Termwise isomorphisms that make the differential square commute preserve both shifted Hom dimensions.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.shiftedHomFinrank_le_of_isPresilting_of_class_eq (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P Q : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (hclass : P.projectiveClass = Q.projectiveClass) (V : TwoTerm R) :
    shiftedHomFinrank k P V ≤ shiftedHomFinrank k Q V ∧ shiftedHomFinrank k V P ≤ shiftedHomFinrank k V Q

    A presilting complex minimizes both shifted Hom dimensions among complexes of its projective class. Adding contractible complexes gives common terms, so this comparison requires no minimal representatives.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.shiftedHomFinrank_mediant_bounds (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (E L Z : TwoTerm R) (hE : E.IsPresilting) (hL : L.IsPresilting) (hZ : Z.IsPresilting) (hEL : shiftedHomFinrank k E L = 0) (hLE : 0 < shiftedHomFinrank k L E) (hclass : Z.projectiveClass = E.projectiveClass + L.projectiveClass) :
    shiftedHomFinrank k E Z = 0 ∧ shiftedHomFinrank k Z L = 0 ∧ shiftedHomFinrank k Z E < shiftedHomFinrank k L E ∧ shiftedHomFinrank k L Z < shiftedHomFinrank k L E

    The presilting representative of the sum class satisfies the four inequalities needed to subdivide a sector.
